title: BACKND Base example game tutorials
summary: Complete example-game walkthroughs (Idle Tycoon, Idle, Highscore) showing how BACKND Base features are wired together in a real Unity project: login, tables and leaderboard, chart and probability, IAP and receipt, version check, post and notice.
capabilities: route 'is there a full sample game' questions to the right example project
map an example game to the BACKND features it demonstrates
guide learners from a feature to where it appears in a sample
prerequisites: Unity and the BACKND SDK are installed
The learner wants an end-to-end sample rather than a single API
common_pitfalls: Copying example-game code as production-ready without verifying current APIs
Assuming the sample's SDK version matches the current SDK
verification_required_for: exact sample code and SDK version assumptions
whether a demonstrated API is still current
verification_strategy: Use https://docs.backnd.com plus the source route, and verify each demonstrated call against its feature topic before reuse.
Treat sample code as illustrative, not as the current API contract.
public_notes: These are learning samples; exact APIs must be confirmed from feature reference pages.
Good for onboarding and architecture orientation, not as a frozen code source.
